Questions

What is the median annual wage for Financial analysts in Seattle?

The OEWS May 2025 annual median for Financial and Investment Analysts in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA is $124,790.

What is the hourly median for Financial analysts in Seattle?

The OEWS May 2025 hourly median for Financial and Investment Analysts in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA is $60.00.

How many Financial analysts work in Seattle?

OEWS May 2025 estimates 6,170 wage-and-salary Financial and Investment Analysts in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA. Self-employed workers are excluded.

What is the location quotient for Financial analysts in Seattle?

The OEWS May 2025 location quotient is 1.27. Values above 1.00 mean Financial and Investment Analysts are more concentrated in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA than in the national occupational mix.

What is the mean annual wage for Financial analysts in Seattle?

The OEWS May 2025 annual mean for Financial and Investment Analysts in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA is $128,460.

How does Seattle's Financial analysts median compare to the other WageGrid metros?

Seattle's published OEWS May 2025 annual median ($124,790) is $23,260 higher than Austin ($101,530) and $23,040 higher than Chicago ($101,750). These are published medians minus published medians. WageGrid does not adjust for cost of living.

Does this wage include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS estimates cover wage-and-salary workers and exclude the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment figure.

Why is a wage cell blank?

BLS withholds some OEWS estimates for quality or confidentiality. WageGrid does not fill those cells.
